inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev17 SQUID, dev16 PROGRESSIVE UFO classic, dev15 GIGANTIC UFO, dev14 CENTIPEDE, dev13 VERTEBRATE, dev12 UNKNOWN, dev11 BUTTERFLY, dev10 HORNET, dev9 ULTIMATE UFO, dev8 MANDALA and earlier native-format/mod/source-only gates remain inherited. Dev18 adds AXON without changing prior assembly catalogs.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, then passed 100/100 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and AXON three-form exact-two-ring checks.

final_package.note: Final package is produced as a fixed-metadata deterministic ZIP pair. Before the final metadata freeze, a byte-identical rehearsal pair and untouched fresh extraction passed manifest, pre-execution source audit, 100/100 selftests, CLI version, and GUI AXON checks; the final pair is rebuilt and rechecked after this report is frozen.

limitations: AXON expanded-petal export is the executable-backed stable phase-angle-0 expanded snapshot; dev18 does not invent continuous petal animation timing beyond the recovered runtime transform equations.

AXON native A5 whole-body and subordinate CA/CB representations are exported as separate catalogs because the executable explicitly switches their visibility rather than stacking both representations.
Fresh retail Xbox game data was used only for external validation; no proprietary package, GMX, or generated retail glTF is bundled.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
